اعتذرتن (form VIII)
# اِعْتَذَرْتُنَّ (iʕtaḏartunna) /iʕ.ta.ðar.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِعْتَذَرَ (iʕtaḏara)
# اُعْتُذِرْتُنَّ (uʕtuḏirtunna) /uʕ.tu.ðir.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِعْتَذَرَ (iʕtaḏara)
